description: Use when you need one ERC-20 balance for one wallet: balanceOf, decimals and symbol read in a single multicall on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism, with raw units, a decimal amount. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/erc20-balance, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One token on one chain; for several tokens or chains at once use wallet_balance. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

chain.description: Chain where the token is deployed; default base

token.description: ERC-20 contract address on the chosen chain; a non-token address is refused before any charge
